content.value_statement: Convex incidents can be difficult to explain from large log streams and health events. This skill produces focused findings with evidence and verification links.
actual_capabilities: Identifies the selected Convex deployment before reading operational data.
Discovers valid function names and deployment details through functionSpec and status.
Groups recent failures by function and error message with representative evidence.
Reviews typed health events for read-limit and optimistic concurrency issues.
Traces one request or function within a bounded recent log window.
Correlates failure onset with deployment status and constructs dashboard links when possible.
limitations: Requires access to the official Convex MCP and an authorized deployment.
Logs accept a history count, not a server-side time range or function filter.
Insights are limited to supported cloud deployments and user-authenticated access.
Correlation can suggest deploy causality but cannot prove it.

use_cases.title: Triage Production Failures
use_cases.description: Group recent failures and inspect representative evidence without returning a full log dump.

use_cases.title: Assess Deployment Impact
use_cases.description: Compare failure onset with the active deployment version before deciding whether a release caused an incident.

use_cases.title: Review Application Health
use_cases.description: Rank recent read-limit and concurrency events before handing optimization work to the appropriate specialist.

prompt_templates.title: Check Recent Failures
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect recent failures in my Convex deployment. Group them by function and error, then show counts and one representative log line.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner triage of current application errors.

prompt_templates.title: Trace One Request
prompt_templates.prompt: Trace request {requestId} in deployment {deployment}. Explain the failure sequence and cite the relevant log evidence.
prompt_templates.scenario: Focused diagnosis of a known request.

prompt_templates.title: Review Health Events
prompt_templates.prompt: Review recent Convex insights for {deployment}. Rank read-limit and concurrency events, and identify which items need deeper performance analysis.
prompt_templates.scenario: Prioritized health review for a backend team.

prompt_templates.title: Correlate a Deployment
prompt_templates.prompt: Determine whether deployment {deployment} correlates with failures in {function}. Compare deployment status with failure onset and clearly separate evidence from inference.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced release impact analysis with cautious causal reasoning.

output_examples.input: What is failing in the current production deployment?
output_examples.output: Finding: api.createOrder produced 18 recent failures with the same validation error. Evidence: the first failure followed a missing customer identifier. Verify in the deployment Logs view.

output_examples.input: Did the latest deployment break user synchronization?
output_examples.output: The synchronization failures began shortly after the current deployment became active. The timing supports correlation, but the available evidence does not prove causation.
The request reached users.sync, then stopped on an authorization error. One representative log entry identifies the rejected operation and its timestamp.

best_practices: Name the deployment and requested function before analysis begins.
Use bounded history windows and aggregate repeated failures.
Verify conclusions through cited evidence and the provided dashboard link.
anti_patterns: Do not guess function names or unsupported query parameters.
Do not return unfiltered raw log dumps.
Do not claim deployment causality from timing alone.

faq.question: Does this skill modify my Convex deployment?
faq.answer: No. Its workflow is read-only and explicitly prohibits production mutation flags.

faq.question: Which Convex data does it inspect?
faq.answer: It can inspect logs, insights, function specifications, and deployment status through the official Convex MCP.

faq.question: Can it filter logs by function on the server?
faq.answer: No. It fetches a bounded history window and applies function, status, or request filters locally.

faq.question: Can it prove that a deployment caused a failure?
faq.answer: No. It compares timestamps and deployment status, then reports correlation without claiming proof.

faq.question: Does it fix performance or cost problems?
faq.answer: No. It surfaces relevant evidence and directs deeper performance or cost work to convex-advisor.

faq.question: What does a typical answer include?
faq.answer: An answer includes one finding, supporting counts, representative evidence, and a dashboard link when construction is possible.
